# Temple Scroll Column 47 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Temple Scroll Column 47 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 47:1 — "rash utterance of her lips" vs. "rash utterance of her lips" vs. "rash promises" — mivta rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the rash utterance of her lips" | Literal mivta sefateyha |
| LOGOS | "the rash utterance of her lips" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "her rash promises" | Simplified modern |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the rash utterance of her lips" per EMET and LOGOS. The fuller phrasing preserves the Hebrew's emphasis on verbal commitment.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 47:3 — "forgive" vs. "pardon" vs. "release" — salach rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the LORD will forgive her" | Standard salach |
| LOGOS | "the LORD will pardon her" | Formal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "the LORD will release her" | Dynamic interpretation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "forgive" per EMET and project convention.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 47:6 — "to separate himself" vs. "to dedicate himself" vs. "dedicating themselves" — nazir/nzr rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "to separate himself to the LORD" | Literal root nzr = separate |
| LOGOS | "to dedicate himself to the LORD" | Interpretive — consecration focus |
| PNEUMA | "dedicating themselves to the LORD" | Dynamic with gender-neutral plural |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "to separate himself" per EMET. The root nzr means to separate/set apart, which is the defining act of the Nazirite.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 47:7 — "strong drink" vs. "fermented drink" vs. "beer" — shekar rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "strong drink" | Traditional biblical rendering |
| LOGOS | "fermented drink" | Precise technical term |
| PNEUMA | "beer" | Modern equivalent |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "strong drink" per EMET. The traditional rendering is well-established and covers the range of non-wine intoxicants.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 47:9 — "locks of the hair" vs. "hair" vs. "hair" — pera rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the locks of the hair of his head" | Literal pera se'ar rosho |
| LOGOS | "the hair of his head to grow uncut" | Formal with interpretation |
| PNEUMA | "their hair grow freely" | Dynamic simplified |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the locks of the hair of his head" per EMET. The literal rendering preserves the distinctive Hebrew phrasing.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 47:14 — "cleansing" vs. "purification" vs. "purification" — taharah rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the day of his cleansing" | Literal taharah |
| LOGOS | "the day of his purification" | Formal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "the day of purification" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "cleansing" per EMET. Both terms are valid; "cleansing" is slightly more literal.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 47:16 — "sin offering" vs. "purification offering" vs. "sin offering" — chattat rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a sin offering" | Project standard chattat |
| LOGOS | "a purification offering" | Functional interpretation |
| PNEUMA | "a sin offering" | Same as EMET |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "sin offering" per EMET and PNEUMA majority and project convention.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/PNEUMA.

---
